one_line: Later Pratihara ruler of a diminished Kannauj, navigating the Ghaznavid raid and fracturing north Indian politics in the early 11th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but dignified build, athletic under courtly layers
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, medium brown North Indian complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing his jaw, default expression thoughtful and alert rather than timid
appearance.hair: thick, straight black hair reaching just past the nape, pulled back and tied low with a narrow red cloth band, front kept tidy with a few controlled strands at the temples; topped by a modest Pratihara-style golden circlet with a central red cabochon and no tall crest
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved knee-length tunic (angarkha-style) of rich deep maroon cotton-silk, crossing left over right and tied with thin internal ties, its edges and cuffs bordered by narrow gold embroidery; over this sits a sleeveless fitted vest of muted gold-yellow fabric with subtle woven geometric motifs, cinched at the waist by a broad dark brown leather belt with a simple round brass buckle; his lower garment is a cream-coloured dhoti wrapped tightly and neatly around the legs in a North Indian style, pleats falling in front and the ends tucked at the waist, the dhoti border featuring a slim maroon and black stripe; he wears a light ochre cotton shawl with a faint block-printed pattern of small repeating circles, draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, practical enough to be gathered over the head when travelling; his feet are in brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes; jewelry is restrained—small round gold stud earrings, a single short gold chain with a tiny pendant resting at the upper chest, and one plain gold ring on his right hand—evoking a ruler of reduced means but still royal; beneath the tunic vest he has simple iron scale patches at the shoulders and upper torso hinted by subtle contouring, evoking light armor without full battle plating.
appearance.signature: A plain but well-crafted straight sword (early talwar-like form) with a slightly curved single-edged steel blade, a simple iron cross-guard, and a dark brown leather-wrapped hilt ending in a small disc pommel; its undecorated scabbard of dark brown leather with brass fittings hangs from his belt on the left, his right hand often resting on the hilt to show a ruler aware of military realities even when avoiding futile direct battle.

ref_desc: Rajyapala is a mid-30s North Indian ruler with tied-back black hair, maroon angarkha, muted gold vest, cream dhoti, ochre shawl, light jewelry, brown mojari shoes, and a plain dark-brown-hilt sword in a simple scabbard, in deep maroon, cream, muted gold, dark brown, and ochre tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rajyapala of Kannauj: a mid-30s North Indian ruler with an oval medium-brown face, sharp dark eyes, neat moustache and short beard, and thick straight black hair tied back low with a red cloth band beneath a modest golden circlet with a central red gem. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length deep maroon angarkha-style tunic with narrow gold borders and cuffs, a sleeveless fitted muted gold-yellow vest with subtle geometric weaving, and a tightly wrapped cream dhoti with slim maroon and black border stripes. A light ochre cotton shawl with faint circular block prints is draped over his left shoulder across his chest, suggesting travel and courtly practicality. Show hints of light iron scale armor under his upper garments at the shoulders and torso, but keep him primarily in cloth and leather. Belt him with a broad dark brown leather belt and give him brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes. Add small round gold stud earrings, a short gold chain with a tiny pendant, and one plain gold ring on his right hand. His signature plain straight sword, with slightly curved single-edged steel blade, simple iron cross-guard, dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, and undecorated dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, hangs from his belt on the left, with his right hand lightly touching the hilt. Use a grounded palette of deep maroon, cream, muted gold-yellow, dark brown, and ochre, and show him from front and slight angle to clearly capture his face, tied-back hair, circlet, layered garments, shawl, footwear, and sword placement.
